+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Model-free HTTP/SSE fixture. Never imports or launches llama.cpp."""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import signal
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+import time
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    def log_message(self, *args):
+        pass
+
+    def reply(self, status, data):
+        body = json.dumps(data).encode()
+        self.send_response(status)
+        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
+        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
+        self.end_headers()
+        self.wfile.write(body)
+
+    def do_GET(self):
+        if self.path == "/health":
+            self.reply(503 if self.server.options.scenario == "unready" else 200, {"status": "ok"})
+        elif self.path == "/props":
+            self.reply(200, {"fixture": True, "model": None})
+        elif self.path == "/slots":
+            with self.server.lock:
+                slots = list(self.server.active.values())
+            self.reply(200, slots)
+        else:
+            self.reply(404, {})
+
+    def do_POST(self):
+        payload = json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"])))
+        if self.path == "/tokenize":
+            self.reply(200, {"tokens": ([1] if payload.get("add_special") else []) + [10, 11, 12]})
+            return
+        options = self.server.options
+        scenario = options.scenario
+        if scenario == "http_error":
+            self.reply(500, {"error": "fixture HTTP failure"})
+            return
+        if scenario == "disconnect":
+            os._exit(9)
+        self.send_response(200)
+        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
+        self.end_headers()
+        slot_id = payload.get("id_slot", 0)
+        try:
+            if scenario == "idle":
+                time.sleep(2)
+                return
+            if scenario == "trickle":
+                for _ in range(100):
+                    self.wfile.write(b" ")
+                    self.wfile.flush()
+                    time.sleep(0.01)
+                return
+            if scenario == "malformed":
+                self.wfile.write(b"data: not-json\n\n")
+                self.wfile.flush()
+                return
+            if scenario == "sse_error":
+                self.event({"error": "fixture SSE failure"})
+                return
+            if scenario == "truncated":
+                self.wfile.write(b"data: {\"tokens\": [1]")
+                self.wfile.flush()
+                return
+            is_long = len(payload["prompt"]) > 256
+            if is_long and scenario == "no_overlap":
+                time.sleep(0.5)
+            with self.server.lock:
+                self.server.active[slot_id] = {"id": slot_id, "is_processing": True,
+                                              "n_prompt_tokens_processed": len(payload["prompt"]) // 2 if is_long else len(payload["prompt"]),
+                                              "next_token": {"n_decoded": self.server.last_counts.get(slot_id, 0)}}
+            if payload.get("return_progress"):
+                self.event({"tokens": [-1], "stop": False, "id_slot": payload.get("id_slot", 0),
+                            "prompt_progress": {"processed": 0, "total": len(payload["prompt"]), "cache": 0, "time_ms": 0}})
+                if is_long:
+                    time.sleep(0.06)
+                    self.event({"tokens": [-1], "stop": False, "prompt_progress": {
+                        "processed": len(payload["prompt"]), "total": len(payload["prompt"]), "cache": 0, "time_ms": 60}})
+            n = payload["n_predict"]
+            group = options.group_size
+            sent = 0
+            self.wfile.write(b": fixture ping\r\n\r\n")
+            while sent < n:
+                ids = list(range(sent + 100, min(sent + group, n) + 100))
+                sent += len(ids)
+                with self.server.lock:
+                    self.server.active[slot_id] = {"id": slot_id, "is_processing": True,
+                                                  "n_prompt_tokens_processed": len(payload["prompt"]), "next_token": {"n_decoded": sent}}
+                    self.server.last_counts[slot_id] = sent
+                self.event({"content": "x" * len(ids), "tokens": ids, "stop": False,
+                            "tokens_predicted": sent, "fixture_sent_ns": time.monotonic_ns()})
+                if options.interval:
+                    time.sleep(options.interval)
+            terminal = {"tokens": list(range(100, n + 100)) if scenario == "terminal_tokens" else [],
+                        "stop": True, "stop_type": "limit", "tokens_predicted": n + int(scenario == "count_mismatch"),
+                        "tokens_evaluated": len(payload["prompt"]), "truncated": False,
+                        "timings": {"prompt_n": len(payload["prompt"]), "predicted_n": n}}
+            self.event(terminal)
+        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):
+            pass
+        finally:
+            with self.server.lock:
+                self.server.active.pop(slot_id, None)
+
+    def event(self, data):
+        self.wfile.write(b"data:" + json.dumps(data).encode() + b"\r\n\r\n")
+        self.wfile.flush()
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--scenario", default="normal")
+    parser.add_argument("--interval", type=float, default=0.01)
+    parser.add_argument("--group-size", type=int, default=1)
+    parser.add_argument("--grandchild-pid", type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.scenario == "startup_exit":
+        return 7
+    if args.scenario == "ignore_term":
+        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)
+    if args.grandchild_pid:
+        child = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", "import time; time.sleep(300)"])
+        args.grandchild_pid.write_text(str(child.pid))
+    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", args.port), Handler)
+    server.daemon_threads = True
+    server.options = args
+    server.lock = threading.Lock()
+    server.active = {}
+    server.last_counts = {}
+    server.serve_forever(poll_interval=0.02)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Measure this client's overhead against a separate, model-free SSE producer."""
+
+import argparse
+import concurrent.futures
+import itertools
+import json
+import math
+import os
+import signal
+import sys
+import threading
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import runner
+
+
+def run_check(output, events=1000, concurrencies=(1, 4), intervals=(0, 0.001), group_sizes=(1, 4), max_p95_lag_ms=50, cancel=None):
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    cancel = cancel or threading.Event()
+    results = []
+    for index, (concurrency, interval, group) in enumerate(itertools.product(concurrencies, intervals, group_sizes)):
+        if cancel.is_set():
+            break
+        directory = output / f"case-{index}"
+        directory.mkdir()
+        port = runner.free_port()
+        command = [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).with_name("fixture_server.py")), "--port", str(port),
+                   "--interval", str(interval), "--group-size", str(group)]
+        server = runner.Server(command, port, directory / "producer.log")
+        case = {"concurrency": concurrency, "interval_s": interval, "group_size": group,
+                "events_per_request": events, "status": "failed"}
+        try:
+            server.start(5, cancel)
+            barrier = threading.Barrier(concurrency)
+
+            def request(i):
+                barrier.wait(timeout=5)
+                return runner.stream_request(port, {"prompt": [1], "n_predict": events * group}, f"decode_{i}",
+                                             directory / f"request-{i}.sse.jsonl", max(10, events * interval * 4), cancel)
+
+            server_before = runner.cpu_seconds(server.process.pid)
+            client_before, start = time.process_time(), time.monotonic_ns()
+            with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=concurrency) as executor:
+                records = list(executor.map(request, range(concurrency)))
+            end, client_after = time.monotonic_ns(), time.process_time()
+            client_cpu = client_after - client_before
+            lags = [(event["t_ns"] - event["data"]["fixture_sent_ns"]) / 1e6
+                    for record in records for event in record["events"] if "fixture_sent_ns" in event["data"]]
+            wall_s = (end - start) / 1e9
+            p95 = runner.percentile(lags)
+            passed = all(r["status"] == "ok" for r in records) and len(lags) == events * concurrency and all(lag >= 0 for lag in lags)
+            passed = passed and p95 is not None and p95 <= max_p95_lag_ms
+            case.update(status="ok" if passed else "failed", wall_s=wall_s, client_cpu_s=client_cpu,
+                        producer_cpu_s=runner.cpu_seconds(server.process.pid) - server_before,
+                        client_cpu_s_per_event=client_cpu / len(lags) if lags else None,
+                        client_cpu_fraction_of_one_core=client_cpu / wall_s,
+                        received_events=len(lags), events_per_s=len(lags) / wall_s,
+                        lag_p50_ms=runner.percentile(lags, 0.5), lag_p95_ms=p95, lag_max_ms=max(lags, default=None))
+            runner.write_json(directory / "requests.json", records)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            case["error"] = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
+        finally:
+            server.stop()
+            case["cleanup"] = server.cleanup
+            results.append(case)
+            runner.write_json(output / "cases.json", results)
+    report = {"model_free": True, "status": "cancelled" if cancel.is_set() else "ok" if all(r["status"] == "ok" for r in results) else "failed",
+              "max_p95_lag_ms": max_p95_lag_ms, "cases": results,
+              "client": runner.process_environment(os.getpid()),
+              "runtime": runner.runtime_env(), "python": sys.version, "runner": runner.identity(runner.__file__),
+              "fixture": runner.identity(Path(__file__).with_name("fixture_server.py")),
+              "interpretation": "same-host producer timestamp to complete SSE frame receive; includes producer serialization, scheduling, network and client work; not model latency"}
+    runner.write_json(output / "summary.json", report)
+    return report
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--events", type=int, default=1000)
+    parser.add_argument("--max-p95-lag-ms", type=float, default=50)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.events < 1 or not math.isfinite(args.max_p95_lag_ms) or args.max_p95_lag_ms <= 0:
+        parser.error("events and lag budget must be positive")
+    cancel = threading.Event()
+    for sig in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM):
+        signal.signal(sig, lambda signum, frame: cancel.set())
+    report = run_check(args.output.resolve(), args.events, max_p95_lag_ms=args.max_p95_lag_ms, cancel=cancel)
+    print(json.dumps({"model_free": True, "status": report["status"], "cases": len(report["cases"]), "output": str(args.output.resolve())}))
+    return 0 if report["status"] == "ok" else 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+def sha256(path):
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with Path(path).open("rb") as source:
+        for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            h.update(block)
+    return h.hexdigest()
+
+
+def identity(path):
+    path = Path(path).resolve(strict=True)
+    return {"path": str(path), "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": sha256(path)}
+
+
+def read_text(path):
+    try:
+        return Path(path).read_text()
+    except OSError as exc:
+        return {"unavailable": str(exc)}
+
+
+def command_output(args):
+    try:
+        result = subprocess.run(args, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
+        return {"returncode": result.returncode, "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr}
+    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
+        return {"unavailable": str(exc)}

+def cpu_seconds(pid):
+    stat = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/stat").read_text()
+    fields = stat[stat.rfind(")") + 2:].split()
+    return (int(fields[11]) + int(fields[12])) / os.sysconf("SC_CLK_TCK")
+
+
+def cgroups(pid):
+    membership = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/cgroup").read_text()
+    mounts = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/mountinfo").read_text()
+    files = {}
+    for line in mounts.splitlines():
+        before, after = line.split(" - ", 1)
+        fs, _, options = after.split()[:3]
+        if fs not in ("cgroup", "cgroup2"):
+            continue
+        parts = before.split()
+        mount_root, mount_path = parts[3:5]
+        for member in membership.splitlines():
+            _, controllers, member_path = member.split(":", 2)
+            if fs == "cgroup" and not set(controllers.split(",")) & set(options.split(",")):
+                continue
+            if fs == "cgroup2" and controllers:
+                continue
+            relative = os.path.relpath(member_path, mount_root)
+            if relative.startswith(".."):
+                relative = "."
+            directory = Path(mount_path) / relative
+            boundary = Path(mount_path)
+            while True:
+                for name in ("cpu.max", "cpu.stat", "cpuset.cpus.effective", "cpu.cfs_quota_us", "cpu.cfs_period_us", "cpuset.cpus"):
+                    path = directory / name
+                    if path.exists():
+                        files[str(path)] = read_text(path)
+                if directory == boundary:

+                directory = directory.parent

+def process_environment(pid):

+def json_request(port, method, path, payload=None, timeout=2):

+    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
+    timer = None

+        def abort():
+            with contextlib.suppress(OSError):

+        if response.status != 200:

+                                        start_new_session=True, env=self.env)
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout

+            try:
+                json_request(self.port, "GET", "/health", timeout=min(0.5, max(0.01, deadline - time.monotonic())))

+    def stop(self):

+            if self.log:
+                self.log.close()
+            return

+        forced = False
+        try:
+            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
+        except ProcessLookupError:
+            pass
+        try:
+            process.wait(timeout=self.cleanup_timeout)
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:

+        # Also stop descendants if the leader exited first.
+        try:
+            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+        except ProcessLookupError:
+            pass
+        process.wait(timeout=self.cleanup_timeout)
+        self.log.close()
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + self.cleanup_timeout
+        while True:
+            live = []
+            for stat in Path("/proc").glob("[0-9]*/stat"):
+                try:
+                    text = stat.read_text()
+                    fields = text[text.rfind(")") + 2:].split()
+                    if int(fields[2]) == process.pid and fields[0] != "Z":
+                        live.append(int(stat.parent.name))
+                except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError):
+                    continue
+            if not live:
+                break
+            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"process group still has live members: {live}")
+            time.sleep(0.01)
+        self.cleanup = {"pid": process.pid, "returncode": process.returncode, "forced_leader_kill": forced,
+                        "leader_reaped": True, "live_group_members": live}

+def stream_request(port, payload, role, raw_path, timeout, cancel, deadline_ns=None, on_tokens=None):
+    start = time.monotonic_ns()
+    deadline_ns = min(deadline_ns or start + int(timeout * 1e9), start + int(timeout * 1e9))
+    record = {"role": role, "payload": payload, "start_ns": start, "events": [], "status": "failed", "raw_sse": str(raw_path)}
+    connection = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", port, timeout=max(0.001, (deadline_ns - start) / 1e9))
+    finished = threading.Event()
+    expired = threading.Event()
+    watchdog = None
+    try:
+        raw_path.touch(exist_ok=False)
+        if cancel.is_set():
+            raise InterruptedError("request cancelled before connect")
+        connection.connect()
+        wire = connection.sock
+
+        def abort():
+            while not finished.wait(0.02):
+                if cancel.is_set() or time.monotonic_ns() >= deadline_ns:
+                    expired.set()
+                    with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
+                        wire.shutdown(socket.SHUT_RDWR)
+                    return
+
+        watchdog = threading.Thread(target=abort, daemon=True)
+        watchdog.start()
+        connection.request("POST", "/completion", body=json.dumps(payload), headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
+        response = connection.getresponse()
+        record.update(headers_ns=time.monotonic_ns(), http_status=response.status, headers=response.getheaders())
+        if response.status != 200:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"HTTP {response.status}: {response.read(4096)!r}")
+        if "text/event-stream" not in response.getheader("Content-Type", ""):
+            raise ValueError("response is not SSE")
+        frame = []
+        with raw_path.open("w", buffering=1024 * 1024) as raw_file:
+            while True:
+                try:
+                    line = response.readline(1024 * 1024 + 1)
+                except Exception:
+                    if frame:
+                        raw_file.write(json.dumps({"t_ns": time.monotonic_ns(), "incomplete": True, "raw_b64": base64.b64encode(b"".join(frame)).decode()}) + "\n")
+                    raise
+                now = time.monotonic_ns()
+                if not line:
+                    if frame:
+                        raw_file.write(json.dumps({"t_ns": now, "incomplete": True, "raw_b64": base64.b64encode(b"".join(frame)).decode()}) + "\n")
+                    break
+                frame.append(line)
+                if len(line) > 1024 * 1024 or sum(map(len, frame)) > 4 * 1024 * 1024:
+                    raw_file.write(json.dumps({"t_ns": now, "incomplete": True, "raw_b64": base64.b64encode(b"".join(frame)).decode()}) + "\n")
+                    raise ValueError("SSE frame size limit exceeded")
+                if line not in (b"\n", b"\r\n"):
+                    continue
+                raw = b"".join(frame)
+                frame = []
+                raw_file.write(json.dumps({"t_ns": now, "raw_b64": base64.b64encode(raw).decode()}) + "\n")
+                fields = [part[5:].lstrip(b" ").rstrip(b"\r\n") for part in raw.splitlines(keepends=True) if part.startswith(b"data:")]
+                if not fields:
+                    continue
+                body = b"\n".join(fields)
+                if body == b"[DONE]":
+                    break
+                data = json.loads(body)
+                if not isinstance(data, dict) or "error" in data:
+                    raise ValueError(f"invalid completion event: {data!r}")
+                tokens = token_ids(data)
+                record["events"].append({"t_ns": now, "data": data})
+                if tokens and on_tokens:
+                    on_tokens(len(tokens))
+                if data.get("stop"):
+                    record["status"] = "ok"
+                    break
+        if record["status"] != "ok":
+            raise ValueError("stream ended without terminal completion event")
+        final = record["events"][-1]["data"]
+        count = sum(len(token_ids(e["data"])) for e in record["events"])
+        record["output_tokens"] = final.get("tokens_predicted")
+        if type(record["output_tokens"]) is not int or count != record["output_tokens"]:
+            raise ValueError(f"output count mismatch: streamed={count}, terminal={record['output_tokens']}")
+        if count != payload["n_predict"] or final.get("truncated") or final.get("stop_type") != "limit":
+            raise ValueError("unexpected output length, truncation, or stop reason")
+        if expired.is_set() or time.monotonic_ns() >= deadline_ns:
+            raise TimeoutError("request deadline exceeded")
+    except Exception as exc:
+        record["status"] = "cancelled" if cancel.is_set() else "timeout" if expired.is_set() or isinstance(exc, TimeoutError) else "failed"
+        record["error"] = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
+    finally:
+        finished.set()
+        connection.close()
+        if watchdog:
+            watchdog.join(timeout=1)
+        record["end_ns"] = time.monotonic_ns()
+        record["streamed_tokens"] = sum(len(token_ids(e["data"])) for e in record["events"])
+    return record

+def request_metrics(request):

+        "valid_token_intervals_ms": intervals, "p95_token_interval_ms": percentile(intervals),
+        "max_token_interval_ms": max(intervals, default=None), "max_event_gap_ms": max(gaps, default=None),
+        "terminal_silence_ms": tail, "grouped_events": sum(len(tokens) > 1 for _, tokens in events),

+def overlap_evidence(requests, observations=()):
+    long = next((r for r in requests if r["role"] == "long_prefill"), None)
+    if long is None:
+        return None
+    progress = [e for e in long["events"] if "prompt_progress" in e["data"]]
+    tokens = [e for e in long["events"] if token_ids(e["data"])]
+    proofs = []
+    if progress and tokens:
+        admission, first_output = progress[0]["t_ns"], tokens[0]["t_ns"]
+        for request in requests:
+            if request["role"] == "long_prefill":
+                continue
+            arrivals = [e["t_ns"] for e in request["events"] if token_ids(e["data"])]
+            # A decode token on each side of admission rules out queued-only overlap.
+            valid = any(t < admission for t in arrivals) and any(admission < t < first_output for t in arrivals)
+            short_id, long_id = request["payload"]["id_slot"], long["payload"]["id_slot"]
+            active = []
+            for observation in observations:
+                slots = {slot["id"]: slot for slot in observation.get("slots", [])}
+                short_slot, long_slot = slots.get(short_id, {}), slots.get(long_id, {})
+                processed = long_slot.get("n_prompt_tokens_processed", -1)
+                if (short_slot.get("is_processing") and short_slot.get("next_token", {}).get("n_decoded", 0) > 0
+                        and long_slot.get("is_processing") and 0 < processed < len(long["payload"]["prompt"])):
+                    active.append(observation["end_ns"])
+            proofs.append({"role": request["role"], "overlap": valid and bool(active), "admission_ns": admission,
+                           "long_first_token_ns": first_output, "simultaneous_active_slot_snapshots_ns": active})
+    expected = len(requests) - 1
+    return {"valid": len(proofs) == expected and all(p["overlap"] for p in proofs), "proofs": proofs,
+            "definition": "each short emits before and during long prefill; /slots also shows both active, short decoded > 0 and long prompt partially processed"}

+def trial_metrics(requests, server_cpu, client_cpu, elapsed_s, observations=()):
+    metrics = [request_metrics(r) for r in requests]
+    p95s = [m["p95_token_interval_ms"] for m in metrics]
+    decode_p95s = [m["p95_token_interval_ms"] for r, m in zip(requests, metrics) if r["role"].startswith("decode_")]
+    output = sum(r.get("output_tokens") or 0 for r in requests)
+    good = all(r["status"] == "ok" for r in requests) and server_cpu is not None
+    overlap = overlap_evidence(requests, observations)
+    good = good and (overlap is None or overlap["valid"])
+    return {
+        "requests": metrics, "overlap": overlap, "valid": good, "elapsed_s": elapsed_s,
+        "server_cpu_s": server_cpu, "client_cpu_s": client_cpu,
+        "output_tokens": output,
+        "worst_request_p95_interval_ms": max(p95s) if p95s and all(p is not None for p in p95s) else None,
+        "worst_decode_request_p95_interval_ms": max(decode_p95s) if decode_p95s and all(p is not None for p in decode_p95s) else None,
+        "max_stall_ms": max((m["max_event_gap_ms"] for m in metrics if m["max_event_gap_ms"] is not None), default=None),
+        "throughput_tokens_s": output / elapsed_s if good and elapsed_s > 0 else None,
+        "cpu_s_per_output_token": server_cpu / output if good and output and server_cpu is not None else None,

+        payload = {"prompt": prompts["long" if long else "short"],
+                   "n_predict": config["long_output_tokens"] if long else 1 if name == "pp" else config["output_tokens"],
+                   "stream": True, "return_tokens": True, "return_progress": mixed,
+                   "cache_prompt": False, "ignore_eos": True, "temperature": 0, "seed": config["request_seed"], "id_slot": index}
+        received = 0
+
+        def on_tokens(n):
+            nonlocal received
+            received += n
+            if received >= config["inject_after_tokens"]:
